results.text: Efficacy of diltiazem in angina on effort: a multicenter trial. During a multicenter study 57 patients with exercise-induced angina were evaluated with serial exercise testing to assess the efficacy of diltiazem, a calcium slow channel blocking agent, compared with a placebo. The study consisted of a 1 week single-blind placebo stabilization period followed by a double-blind triple crossover between diltiazem and placebo.
